summary: Python-based enterprise platform following FastAPI patterns with agent-based architecture. Strong emphasis on schema validation, JSON contracts, and Docker containerization.

rules.rule: Agent modules use descriptive names with underscores (analyst.py, database_engineer.py)
FastAPI decorators used for HTTP endpoint definition (@app.get, @app.post)
JSON schema validation enforced for agent contracts and API responses

provenance.evidence: Comprehensive JSON schema definitions for validation

rules.rule: Legacy VB6 code lacks proper error handling and input validation

provenance.evidence: Direct string concatenation without validation or parameterization

rules.rule: Dedicated tester agent module suggests automated testing integration

lint_recommendations: Implement SQL parameterization for legacy VB6 database queries
Add input validation for txtAccountNo and txtAmount fields
Enforce JSON schema validation in all agent communication
Add comprehensive error handling for database connection failures
Implement logging standards across all agent modules

Entity Framework model template for Customer/Account entities
